_note: Manifests say model: sonnet, opus or haiku. This maps those names to exact Claude model IDs, so a new model release never changes your runs until you edit this file. Run `node run.mjs run <slug> --model <name>` to use another model for one run: <name> is sonnet, opus or haiku, or any exact ID that starts with claude-. 'review' is the model of the read-only review sessions (the manifest can override it with review_model). Claude Code has no automatic switch to another model: when the usage limit is reached every model is blocked, so the runner waits (max_limit_wait_hours).
